Theory uncertainty estimation
• Theory uncertainties for W+jets and top background are estimated, by following PMG
recommendations.

• The uncertainty of “transfer factor (CR→SR)” is estimated.
• Most of uncertainties are cancelled out between SR/VR and CR and found to be less than
20%.
• CR definition is good, and we can use the phase space very similar to SR/VR.
• Uncertainties affected by poor MC statistics are evaluated with looser selection cuts and

• 𝑍 → 𝜈𝜈 + 𝜏(fake) is a minor source of background.

Theory uncertainty estimation
• Theory uncertaintiesfor W+jets and top background are estimated, by following PMG
recommendations.
• Exception: the fraction of b/c jets in W+jets affects our analysis, that is, the fraction of b/c jets could be
the source of the W+jets modeling uncertainties when extrapolating the fit results from b-veto CR to
the b-tag SR/VRs.
• We tested with 10%, 20% and 30% uncertainty on W+jets. The sensitivity is not changed so much for
using 20% or 30% (given it is dominated by data stat uncertainty) and 30% is applied in the end.
• The uncertainty of “transferfactor (CR→SR)” is estimated.
• Most of uncertaintiesare cancelled out between SR/VR and CRand found to be less than 20%.
• CR definition is good, and we can use the phase space very similar to SR/VR.
• Uncertaintiesaffected by poor MC statistics are evaluatedwith looser selection cuts and /or
smoothing of distribution.
• 𝑍 → 𝜈𝜈 + 𝜏(fake) is a minor source of background. The MC modeling for fake tau is not perfect, so
we assigned 100% uncertainty on that since we observed disagreement~ 50% between data and
MC in 𝑍 → 𝑙𝑙 + 𝜏(fake) VR.
• Diboson and Z+jets are assigned with 30% mis-modeling uncertainty.(The impact on the value is 
very limited, 30% → 50% corresponds to the sensitivity loss less than 1%)

05/12/2025 Jiaqi ZANGUnblinding Request

Physics motivation – B anomaly
• Lepton Flavor Universality (LFU)
➢Weak interaction is universal for 3 lepton flavors in Standard Model.
05/12/2025 Jiaqi ZANG Unblinding Request 2
• Signs of LFU violation in the B meson decays are reported.
➢ 𝑏 → 𝑐𝑙𝜈 : 𝜏 vs. light leptons (𝜇, 𝑒).
➢ ~ 3.8𝜎 excess over SM (𝐷 and 𝐷∗ combined).
➢ Leptoquark (LQ) is a possible explanation of such violation.
SM
BSM

05/12/2025 Jiaqi ZANG Unblinding Request 3
Theoretical motivation
• We focus on the vector LQ (U1 scenario) :
• Regarding the previous LQ searches in CMS and ATLAS:
➢ Pair production: Not depend on the LQ coupling. 𝑚𝐿𝑄 < 1.5 TeV are excluded.
➢ Non-resonant production:
▪ Strongly depends on the LQ coupling, gives a chance to reach unexplored
high-mass region.
▪ CMS and ATLAS has performed the search with 𝜏𝜏 final states, but it’s
sensitive to 𝛽𝐿
33 only.
 Limit of ATLAS LQ searches
(CMS is similar to ATLAS)
➢ 𝑔𝑈: global coupling constant to normalize 𝛽𝐿
33 = 1.0 (b-tau coupling).
➢ 𝛽𝐿
23 (s-tau coupling): coupling that decide the signal strength together with 𝑔𝑈.
➢ Strength of R(D) anomaly is parameterized by 𝑔𝑈

05/12/2025 Jiaqi ZANG Unblinding Request 4
Targetsignals
• We propose a model-independent search with 𝜏𝜈 + 𝑏 final state.
➢ The same diagram as R(D(*)) anomaly.
➢ Also sensitive to the 𝑐𝜈 coupling, which means the signal strength is dominated by not only 𝑔𝑈, but also coupling
𝛽𝐿
23. → To test the large 𝜷𝑳
𝟐𝟑 scenario. (𝛽𝐿
33 = 1.0)
➢ Can cover all possible scenarios to explain R(D*) by a combination with 𝜏𝜏 search.
➢ Not explored by ATLAS/CMS yet. Reinterpretation of 𝑊′ → 𝜏𝜈 is not so sensitive to LQ signals since they don’t
require b-jet.
Complementarity 2D search
plane of 𝜏𝜈 and 𝜏𝜏 analysis

• Targeting an analysis with only Run-2 data and the quick publication in early 2026. 1st EB
meeting is given on Nov. 3rd . (indico)
• CP kick-off task: general CP contribution by the tau+X umbrella team. It is considered for
spin-off analysis of the umbrella like us.
• We also strongly contributed to the Run-3 ATLAS operation (~300 OTP/year) and PC
agreed that it can be considered.
• Our latest version of internal note has been reviewed by EB members and liaisons. (CDS)

▪ Included all CP recommeded uncertainties to ntuples.

Signal reweightingstudy
• Originally we planned to use the MadGraph internal weights to vary 𝑔𝑈 and 𝛽𝐿
23 coupling.
• Found the internal weights of our MC samples do not consider the width variation depending on 𝑔𝑈.
• We estimated the additional correction factor as a function of M(𝑏, 𝑡𝑎𝑢) and 𝑝𝑇
𝑗𝑒𝑡, and reproduced the
distributions generated by the MadGraph directly without the internal weights.
• Contribution of interference between
BSM and SM is marginal (<5%) after
the high mT cut. The BSM only signals
with additional weights are used in the
following study.
Example of BSM and SM diagram for

• However,after the discussion with PMG experts, this approach is not favored by them, so
we are generating signals at all parameter points. (JIRA)
• The request was approved with high priority.
• EVNT done; Sim ongoing; Reco possibly can be done by the end of this year .
• But the final signal yields must be consistent with the current sample with the internal
weight applied with additional correction.
• In conclusion, we are still waiting for the final version of the signals, but it must NOT be a
showstopper for the unblinding.

• Currently medium muon working point is used for muon selection in the 𝑊 → 𝜇𝜈 and Top CR.

➢ The current ntuple production does not have the HighPt muon working points and the
reproduction will cost > 1 week, while we’d like to unblind before the end of the year due to the
tight schedule.
➢ The ranking of systematics shows that the muon momentum systematics have the low impact
on POI 𝜇.
➢ Our CRs have enough statistics after combining the electron and muon channels → robust to

Theory uncertainty estimation
• Theory uncertainties for W+jets and top background are estimated, by following PMG
recommendations.
• Exception: the fraction of b/c jets in W+jets affects our analysis, that is, the fraction of b/c jets could
be the source of the W+jets modeling uncertainties when extrapolating the fit results from b-veto CR
to the b-tag SR/VRs.
• We tested with 10%, 20% and 30% uncertainty on W+jets. The sensitivity is not changed so much
(given it is dominated by data stat uncertainty). To be finalized before the unblinding. We propose to
use 20%.
• The uncertainty of “transfer factor (CR→SR)” is estimated.
• Most of uncertainties are cancelled out between SR/VR and CR and found to be less than 20%.
• CR definition is good, and we can use the phase space very similar to SR/VR.
• Uncertainties affected by poor MC statistics are evaluated with looser selection cuts and /or
smoothing of distribution.
